name: contract-browser-fixture-loader
goal: Generated shared screenshot fixtures register with Playwright and preserve API-only lazy browser setup

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Actual harbor-mbp-2 browser tests fail before collection: Playwright rejects the new matchScreenshot fixture positional _fixtures parameter. All three existing API/browser cases are blocked by that product fixture.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Static template alignment and TypeScript checks did not execute Playwright fixture registration. Existing three end-to-end cases already assert normal browser diagnostics, screenshot changes and API-only lazy setup; keep the same cases and prove their exact registration failure before repair.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: harbor-mbp-2 retained failing proof1b0cef91 at7f636f855c. The same three cases fail before collection on the matchScreenshot positional fixture parameter; no new test declarations were added.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Use Playwright-required object destructuring for the fixture dependency parameter. Keep the auto fixture lazy for request-only checks. Preserve the unchanged three-case corpus on isolated proof branch7f636f855c→acde70a28e, then synchronize the root/shared fixture only after paired proof.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
